liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments rose by {{cash_like.change@FY2026}} to {{cash_like@FY2026}}, equal to cash liquidity to revenue of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2026}}, up {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2026}} on the prior year.

Debt due within a year fell by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2026}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2026}}, so cash on the balance sheet covers the near-term maturities without new funding, and the group repaid its eurobond out of free cash during the year.

Free cash flow after lease payments rose by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2026}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2026}}, lifting FCF after leases to debt by {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2026}} to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2026}}, the measure that leaves lease payments in financing cash flows.

Customer prepayments remain a large part of the funding base: contract liabilities rose by {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2026}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2026}}, with advance ticket cover at {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2026}}.
